statement: The sequence \(\{x_n\}\) is defined by \(x_1 = \tfrac{1}{2}\) and \(x_n = \dfrac{\sqrt{x_{n-1}^2 + 4x_{n-1}} + x_{n-1}}{2}\). Prove that the sequence \(\{y_n\}\), where \(y_n = \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} \dfrac{1}{x_i^2}\), has a finite limit and find that limit.

Let \(A, B\) be two fixed points and \(C\) a variable point on the plane such that \(\angle ACB = \alpha\) (constant), \(0^\circ \leq \alpha \leq 180^\circ\). Let \(D, E, F\) be the projections of the incenter \(I\) of \(\triangle ABC\) onto sides \(BC, CA, AB\) respectively. Let \(M, N\) be the intersections of \(AI, BI\) with \(EF\) respectively. Prove that the length \(MN\) is constant and that the circumcircle of \(\triangle DMN\) always passes through a fixed point.

Let \(a, b, c\) be three real numbers such that \(a^n + b^n + c^n\) is an integer for every positive integer \(n\). Prove that there exist integers \(p, q, r\) such that \(a, b, c\) are roots of \(x^3 + px^2 + qx + r = 0\).
Let \(S = \{1, 2, 3, \ldots, 2n\}\) (\(n \in \mathbb{Z}^+\)). Determine the number of subsets \(T\) of \(S\) such that no two elements \(a, b \in T\) satisfy \(|a - b| \in \{1, n\}\).
